```{r}
library(here)
source(here("lib", "setup.R"))
source(here("lib", "helper_Seurat.R"))
source(here("lib", "helper.R"))
source(here("lib", "aesthetics.R"))
library(CellChat)

cellchat_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "cellchat_out")
if (!dir.exists(cellchat_dir)) dir.create(cellchat_dir)
```

## Processing

```{r}
so_T <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "so_filterRNA200mito10_subsetTremovedoublets.rds"))
so_M <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "so_filterRNA200mito10_subsetMremovedoublets.rds"))

merged_obj <- merge(x = so_T, y = so_M)
# merged_obj[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(merged_obj)
rm(so_T)
rm(so_M)
```

```{r}
merged_obj_sampled <- subset(merged_obj, cells = sample(colnames(merged_obj), 1e4))
```

```{r}
data.input <- merged_obj_sampled[["RNA"]]@data 
labels <- ifelse(
  is.na(merged_obj_sampled@meta.data$clusters_T), 
  merged_obj_sampled@meta.data$clusters_M, 
  merged_obj_sampled@meta.data$clusters_T
)
Idents(merged_obj_sampled) <- labels
meta <- data.frame(
  labels = labels, 
  row.names = names(labels), 
  samples = factor(merged_obj_sampled@meta.data$mouse)
) 
```

```{r}
table(Idents(merged_obj_sampled))
```

```{r}
cellchat <- createCellChat(object = merged_obj_sampled, group.by = "ident", assay = "RNA")

cellchat <- addMeta(cellchat, meta = meta)
cellchat <- setIdent(cellchat, ident.use = "labels") 
levels(cellchat@idents) 
groupSize <- as.numeric(table(cellchat@idents)) 

rm(merged_obj_sampled)
```


```{r}
CellChatDB <- CellChatDB.mouse
showDatabaseCategory(CellChatDB)
CellChatDB.use <- subsetDB(CellChatDB)
cellchat@DB <- CellChatDB.use
```

```{r}
# subset the expression data of signaling genes for saving computation cost
cellchat <- subsetData(cellchat) # This step is necessary even if using the whole database
#future::plan("multisession", workers = 4) # do parallel
cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat)
cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat)
```

```{r}
cellchat <- computeCommunProb(cellchat, type = "triMean")
# cellchat <- filterCommunication(cellchat, min.cells = 10)
```

```{r}
cellchat <- computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat)
cellchat <- aggregateNet(cellchat)
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
saveRDS(cellchat, file.path(results_dir, "cellchat.rds"))
# cellchat <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "cellchat.rds"))
```

## Analysis

```{r}
df.net <- subsetCommunication(cellchat)
write_csv(as_tibble(df.net), file.path(results_dir, "cellchat_df.net_results.csv"))

df.net.inflamm.monocytes <- df.net %>% 
  as_tibble() %>% 
  filter(source == "7: inflammatory monocyte") 
write_csv(df.net.inflamm.monocytes, file.path(results_dir, "cellchat_df.net_results_from.inflamm.monocytes.csv"))
```

```{r}
mat <- cellchat@net$weight
mat2 <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(mat), ncol = ncol(mat), dimnames = dimnames(mat))

i <- 6
mat2[i, ] <- mat[i, ]
netVisual_circle(mat2, vertex.weight = groupSize, weight.scale = T, edge.weight.max = max(mat), title.name = rownames(mat)[i])
```

```{r}
weight_df <- cellchat@net$weight %>% 
  t() %>% 
  as_tibble(rownames = "cluster") %>% 
  select(cluster, `7: inflammatory monocyte`, `1: Ccr2+ monocyte`) %>% 
  mutate(ratio = `7: inflammatory monocyte` / `1: Ccr2+ monocyte`)
weight_df %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  aes(fct_reorder(cluster, ratio), log10(ratio)) + 
  geom_point(aes(size = `7: inflammatory monocyte`), show.legend = F, alpha = 0.3) + 
  geom_segment(aes(y = 0, yend = log10(ratio))) + 
  coord_flip()
```

netVisual_bubble(cellchat, sources.use = c(22, 6, 13), targets.use = myeloid, signaling = c("APP", "COMPLEMENT", "TNF", "VISFATIN", "SIRP"), remove.isolate = FALSE)
